reviews.title: Best bang for buck nvme
reviews.comment: Very very fast, best bang for buck, upgraded from standard ssd and can definitely tell a difference in upload/download speeds. Stays very cool. Very easy installation and plenty of storage for all my games. I’ve used windows and Linux with no issues. I’ve used in different motherboards and systems and works flawlessly.
reviews.author: Caleb skipper

reviews.title: High Quality and Fast For The Price
reviews.comment:
Works great, needed a cheaper SSD to use in a budget build and this one is decently fast and so far has been really reliable.
Runs cool and uses good quality memory chips so should be reliable!
reviews.author: Alex Russell

reviews.title: Good, reliable product.
reviews.comment: All of my Teamgroup nvmes have been reliable so far, no issues. Just wish I had bought more of them and higher capacities.
reviews.author: Ethan

reviews.title: Extremely Fast NVME from a Reliable Company
reviews.comment:
This isn't my first TEAMGROUP purchase and I can assure you it won't be my last this NVMe is extremely fast and hopefully just as reliable as my other purchases from this manufacturer.  My motherboard immediately recognized the drive and configured it to my asking without any caveats.
Another excellent point is the price point for this drive with a 1 TB storage space.
reviews.author: Carmen A. Hernandez
